description: This file defines a utility enum `AsyncTimeout` that provides asynchronous timeout handling functions. It offers methods to execute an async operation with a specified timeout, either in seconds or milliseconds, and throws an error if the timeout expires.

methods.name: withTimeout<T: Sendable>
methods.description: Runs an asynchronous operation with a timeout specified in seconds. Throws an error if the operation times out.

methods.name: withTimeoutMs<T: Sendable>
methods.description: Runs an asynchronous operation with a timeout specified in milliseconds. Converts milliseconds to seconds and delegates to withTimeout.
